title: Boundaries of the holy land
english: On [[the description of the holy land and its bounds >> Bible:Numbers 34]]: the last history in Numbers — the Lord bids Moses give precepts so they know the bounds of their inheritance.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
SERIES CLOSEOUT 28/28 after Homilia XXVII; land bounds; Homilia III title lacuna stands unrecoverable from Baehrens OCR witness.

title: South, west, north, east

title: SERIES CLOSEOUT — enter the inheritance
english: Let us enter the holy land with virtue’s bounds kept. Rufinus’s twenty-eight Numbers homilies are complete. Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit forever. Amen.
